en:
At the start of each year we choose
the sponsors who back the club. They
provide the funds the club runs on.

You can sign up to 10 sponsors. Weigh
up the amounts and the years, and
choose the best ones carefully.

Some sponsors attach conditions to
their deals. Please decide with our
club's strength in mind.

The contract with this sponsor has
ended.

This sponsor's contract has ended, but
they would like to extend it.
Shall we extend?

=w/The contract with @Y/%s@
has been extended.
We hope for their continued support.=

=k/It was a kind offer, but we
turned down the contract extension
with @Y/%s@.=

=w/@Y/%s@ has widened its remit
thanks to strong results.=

=w/Two of our sponsors, @Y/%s@
and @Y/%s@,
are going to merge.=

=w/The new name will be @Y/%s@.
It seems the merger has widened their
range of business.=

=w/The new name will be @Y/%s@.
The merger has greatly expanded their
range of business.=

A new year has begun, so we will now
sign this year's sponsor contracts.

=k/Perhaps because of the economy, not
a single company made an offer this
year. Let's hope for next year.=

=k/You already have 10 sponsors.
I'm afraid you can't sign any more
new contracts.=

Would you like to sign with this
sponsor?

This sponsor has set conditions.
Are you sure that's all right?
Will you sign with this sponsor?

The deal with @Y/%s@
has been agreed.

You can view the list of sponsors
currently under contract.

You can view the sponsors who have
made offers this year and are not
yet under contract.
End the contract with a sponsor.

These are the sponsors the club
currently has under contract.

=K/We failed to honour our contract,
and this sponsor has announced
it is cancelling the deal.=

=K/That is entirely our fault.
We must be more careful from now on
so we don't lose any more trust.=

J1: 4th or
higher in both
stages

A luxury underwear maker whose brand
is popular with all ages. It seems
to be part of a men's range ad push.

A menswear maker with some of the
industry's best tailoring. They look
set on using the club for their image.

A long-established kimono shop dating
from the Edo period. No big swings in
management, so results are stable.

An international apparel maker selling
clothes worldwide. To get wider
recognition, they have set conditions.

A leisure company that builds and runs
amusement parks and the like. It may
be somewhat affected by the economy.

A games company centred on developing
and selling software. Its fortunes
often follow the economy.

A general entertainment firm, from game
software to amusement parks. The fee
is tempting, but weigh the conditions.

A firm producing original, educational
and business video software. They seem
to take a keen interest in us.

Japan's biggest film company, making
and distributing movies. Its conditions
on TV ratings and publicity are tough.

A company producing CG video to order.
Best technology in the industry, but
poor at weathering the economy.

A company making animation for TV and
film. It has many popular titles, but
it copes poorly with the economy.

A company producing video from CG to
animation. It demands strong results,
and sets conditions on our management.

A long-established firm rooted in our
town. The amount is rather small, but
they plan some kind of special bonus.

A big firm supplying all the propane
gas in the area around our town.
Watch the conditions, okay?

A major firm supplying gas across the
prefecture. Perhaps they want to use
our best players in their adverts?

The city gas company our town knows
well. A very stable firm, untouched by
the economy. There's a special bonus.

The city gas firm vital to our town and
surrounding area. The big fee is
attractive, but mind the conditions.

A major firm providing city gas to
our region. Conditions are rather
strict, but the big fee is tempting.

A firm supplying power to our town.
Its stability in any economy is its
appeal. There's a special bonus too.

A firm supplying power to our region.
It weathers the economy well, which
is a plus, but watch the conditions.

A major company supplying power to
our region. It comes with conditions,
but the sponsorship fee is attractive.

A local shipping company in our town.
They say they will help out on away
trips and the like.

A shipping company serving our area.
They can help with away travel costs,
but please mind the conditions.

The big company that runs shipping
across our region. They can help with
travel costs, but mind the conditions.

A coffee chain that began in our town.
They are happy to help if we want a
shop in the stadium.

A fast food chain popular with young
people. They are happy to help when we
put an outlet in the stadium.

A nationwide family restaurant chain.
The management conditions are strict,
but the money is very attractive.

A conveyor-belt sushi chain known for
its fresh fish. The fee is on the low
side, but the long contract is a plus.

A soba chain praised for hand-made
noodles. The fee is on the low side,
but the long contract is appealing.

A Japanese restaurant chain praised for
home-style food and menus. You'll be
fine if you remember the conditions.

A local home-medicine maker. Because of
its line of work, it is very sensitive
to injuries that harm its image.

A mid-sized drug maker based in our
area. As the conditions say, please
watch out for injuries.

A leading Japanese drug maker. Being so
well known, it is most nervous about
injuries, but the money is superb.

A world-famous, first-class film maker
that everyone knows. The sponsorship
fee is first-class too.

A local company making every kind of
screw. It seems to be a devoted
supporter of our club.

A company making and processing light
metals, mainly aluminium. They may even
consider a bonus depending on results.

A big manufacturer of metals, light
and heavy. It is often swayed by the
economy lately. Mind the conditions.

A non-bank company that issues and runs
credit cards. It follows the economy,
but it backs us enthusiastically.

Japan's biggest insurer, covering every
kind of risk. It seems to be targeting
the Middle East and Asia.

A community-minded regional bank often
talked about for its sound management.
Its president supports the club.

A leading city bank with branches all
over Japan. The sum is top-class too,
but watch its typical bank conditions.

Japan's largest securities firm. It is
prone to market swings, but it takes
a keen interest in our club.

A fairly small air transport company.
They will help on away trips, but the
trade is vulnerable to the economy.

A mid-sized air transport company.
They are willing to help with away
trips. Please mind the conditions.

Japan's biggest air transport company.
The money is very attractive, but the
conditions are strict, so be careful.

A well-known company in our town. They
will help when we extend or rebuild
the facilities.

A company that builds many of the
prefab buildings in our area. They will
help us extend our facilities.

A well-known company that handles most
building painting in our town. They
will help us extend our facilities.

A company doing a lot of plastering
work for our town's construction. They
will help us extend our facilities.

A major builder responsible for a lot
of construction in our region. They
will help us extend our facilities.

A convenience store chain that is now
part of daily life. We see it all over
our town, and the money is attractive.

A supermarket chain with roots in our
town, known for fresh goods and a
wide selection.

A department store found in every major
city of our region, famous for quality
goods. Please mind the conditions.

A company running a chain of discount
stores, centred on our town. Its
rock-bottom prices are very popular.

A menswear retail chain centred on our
town. Lately it seems to be moving into
casual wear.

A taxi company operating mainly in our
town. It looks set to help improve
the town's traffic.

A taxi and chauffeur-hire company.
They may help ease local traffic, but
the conditions are severe.

A company running local bus routes in
our town. They seem keen to improve
the town's transport too.

A bus company covering local routes and
coach tours. Conditions apply, but they
may help improve transport.

A company running most of the buses and
taxis in our region. Judging by the
conditions, it wants to go overseas.

A company running our town's railway.
It is keen to improve transport, so
there may be some special perk.

A mid-sized private railway, vital to
residents and rooted in the area. They
are thinking of using players in ads.

A transport company serving residents
across the whole region. It would like
to use talented players in its ads.

A talent agency with models and TV
personalities. Who knows, one of our
players might get scouted.

A fast internet provider proud of its
service. It also offers a homepage
creation service.

A record company strong in pop music.
It hopes for advertising reach across
all ages and has offered to sponsor.

A driving school for licences from
motorbikes to heavy special vehicles.
It noticed our club's youth appeal.

A regional school helping people get
various driving licences. It is moving
into overseas boat and flying schools.

A driving school covering our whole
region. It wants a better image, so it
is sensitive to our league position.

A maker of plastic materials and
products. They handle lots of small
everyday items and want more exposure.

A company processing and selling timber
for building. It will help when we
extend the club's facilities.

A leading paper maker, though lately it
is under pressure from overseas. It has
backed football for a long time.

A global maker and seller of every
material, from wood to petrochemicals.
It is strict about league position.

A group of supporters who back us of
their own accord. They say they will
keep backing us while the club exists.

A bookshop familiar in our town.
It publishes as well as selling books,
and seems to want to expand.

Besides running a bookshop chain, it
publishes. It may feature the club in
a magazine it puts out.

A well-known printing company in our
town. It is highly rated for its
careful service.

The printing company for our area. They
will help with things like posters, so
we can expect a popularity boost.

Japan's largest publishing printer.
They will help produce signs and ads,
so expect a rise in popularity.

A Japanese sweet shop founded in the
Edo period. It wants to use our club's
profile to promote its new products.

A veteran confectioner that grew with
recent new products. They will help
when we set up a stall in the stadium.

A Japanese and Western confectioner
that grew fast on a string of hits.
It wants the club as its public face.

A drinks maker well known in our area.
Lately it seems to be moving into
alcohol too.

A bakery that is popular for sweet
breads aimed at women. It seems to be
moving into the fast food business.

A big food importer and exporter that
also makes processed goods. It seems to
be considering expansion into Asia.

A timber wholesaler that plants and
fells its own trees. Imports have hurt
it lately, but it backs us keenly.

A company in the forestry business.
A highly efficient planting technique
has recently expanded its operations.

A general forestry firm that plants the
right trees efficiently worldwide. It
will help improve our surroundings.

A company with big interests in our
town's fisheries. Its business ranges
from fishing to seafood processing.

A seafood processor famous nationwide
for canned goods and more. The whole
company is cheering our club on.

A global fish importer, exporter and
processor. Their enthusiasm for
supporting us is remarkable.

A livestock company focused on pig
farming. It also processes meat goods
and wants to go national via the club.

A livestock company focused on pig and
chicken farming. It wants the club's
profile to expand its business.

A general livestock company with farms
worldwide, producing meat cheaply. It
seems to want a still bigger share.

A famous company making everything from
nostalgic toys to character toys. They
are aiming at football toys.

Famous as an office stationery maker.
They are considering kids' stationery
that uses our club.

A firm whose fashion watches are a hit
with young people. It seems to want to
bring out watches as J1 League goods.

A semiconductor and IC maker with the
best precision machining in Japan. It
wants to change its corporate image.

A leading petrol retailer in Japan.
It hopes a campaign using our club
will expand its market share.

A maker of shoes for all sports. As
part of its image strategy, it has put
its name forward as a sponsor.

A company in the news for its new
long-life rubber. Next it wants to grow
by moving into finished products.

A maker of high-grip, long-lasting
winter tyres. Year-end is its peak
season, so it is strict on publicity.

A world-famous maker with a name for
off-road and snow tyres. It is strict
about results in the year-end season.

A well-known leader in skyscraper
construction. It hopes to raise its
profile through our club.

A top general contractor that develops
whole cities. Conditions are tough,
but it will help with the price.

A major company handling international
calls and more. It offered to sponsor
to raise its corporate image.

A company providing international mail
and delivery. It has set its sights on
our club to raise its profile.

A phone company with many discount
plans. It is praised for reliable call
quality, so it expects steady results.

A mobile firm praised for good coverage
and sound quality. It is strict about
results that hurt its reliable image.

A design firm coordinating luxury
rooms. They will help when we build
VIP rooms.

A company selling luxury furniture and
styling whole rooms. They will help
when we set up VIP rooms.

A maker of everything from room lights
to stage lighting. They will help when
the club needs lighting.

A maker mainly of video and audio
equipment. It expects publicity value
from J1, so please be careful.

A maker of electrical appliances, from
home goods to commercial equipment. Its
main market lately is Asia.

A property firm focused on apartment
blocks. It offered to sponsor to lift
the image of housing.

A property company focused on office
rental buildings. It seems very
sensitive to the economy.

A nationwide property company renting
out apartments and buildings. Given its
image, it is strict about results.

A jewellery company that imports,
processes and sells gems worldwide.
No conditions, and the money is good.

A sports newspaper with a local focus.
It carries detailed club news that the
national papers rarely cover.

A nationwide ad agency for print and
video. It aims to top the industry, so
it is strict about club results.

A mail-order company for household
consumables like clothing and food. It
wants more awareness among homemakers.

A mid-sized trading house handling all
sorts of goods in Japan. It hopes to
grow by raising its profile.

A huge trading house dealing in goods
worldwide. It wants to lead in Japan,
so the conditions are strict.

A major car brake manufacturer. With no
barriers between company groups now, it
is looking to sell to other firms.

Japan's biggest carmaker, from small
cars to heavy special vehicles. Being
number one, it is strict on results.

A top motorcycle maker in Japan. Having
won in racing, it now seems to want
success in football too.

A maker of construction machinery and
equipment. Lately it has also taken up
excavation work using its equipment.

A moving company with a big share in
Japan. To grow its share further, it
seems to expect a boost from the club.

Japan's biggest transport company, from
removals to business delivery. It will
help on away trips.

A travel agency many travellers trust.
The conditions include promoting world
cities, but it will help us in return.

A company running hotel chains of every
type, from resorts to business hotels.
It will help on away trips.

A company with several atmospheric hot
spring inns. Frankly the money is low,
but it will help on away trips.
